# Forge

> Forge is a Hack Club program where teen builders (ages 13-18) get their hardware projects funded. You pitch an idea, a reviewer approves it, you document the build in a journal, and Hack Club pays for the parts.

Forge is run by Hack Club, a nonprofit network of high school hackers. Projects move through a tier system that sets how much funding a build can receive, and builders document progress in a `JOURNAL.md` file synced from their GitHub repo. Most of the site requires signing in with a Hack Club account; the pages listed below are public.

## Docs

- [Welcome to Forge](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs): Start here — what Forge is and how to get going
- [How It Works](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/about-forge/how-it-works): The full flow from pitch to funding
- [The Tier and Streak System](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/about-forge/tiers): How tiers set funding limits, and how streaks work
- [FAQ](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/about-forge/FAQ): Common questions about Forge

## Requirements

- [Pitching Your Project](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/requirements/pitching): How to write a pitch that gets approved
- [Project Guidelines](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/requirements/project-guidelines): What counts as a Forge project
- [Submission Requirements](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/requirements/submitting): What your design submission needs to include
- [What is Shipping?](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/requirements/shipping): How to create a good ship

## Design Resources

- [About Funding and Cost](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/design/cost): How much Forge covers and how budgets work
- [Sourcing Parts](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/design/sourcing-parts): Where to find the best and cheapest parts
- [Good Journalling](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/design/how-to-journal): Writing journal entries that document your process
- [JOURNAL.md Format](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/design/journal-format): The exact format Forge parses
- [How to Write a Good README](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/design/readme): Documenting your project repo

## Optional

- [Explore](https://forge.hackclub.com/explore): Public feed of projects other builders have shipped
- [API](https://forge.hackclub.com/docs/Miscellaneous/api): Public API for Forge project data
- [Hack Club](https://hackclub.com): The nonprofit behind Forge
